messages:
Allan: Heads up — Marketing is launching a short "Free Minutes" credit in EU next month. Expect a notable shift in demand profile: more new users, longer chat sessions for onboarding flows. Need a quick GPU-hours forecast + mitigation plan. Baseline EU avg ~4,200 GPU-hrs/week. Marketing expects +18–28% for first 2 weeks. Can you triage impact and suggest immediate ops levers? @Meera @Samir @Lucy
Meera: What kinds of requests are we expecting? embeddings-heavy or generation? :thinking_face: Any geo skew within EU?
Samir: Got rough cohort split from marketing: ~70% chat gen, 25% embeddings, 5% rerank. Geo mostly eu-west-1 and eu-central-1, ~65/35. I ran a tiny sim this morning, will post top-level numbers.
Samir: ```bash
# quick sim command i ran
python infra/sim/demand.py --promo-code free-mins-2026 --region eu --scale 1.2 --seed 42
```
Samir: Quick outputs pasted below (very rough):
Week1 GPU-hrs: baseline 4200 -> projected 5150 (+22.6%)
Week2 GPU-hrs: 4200 -> 4860 (+15.7%)
Peak QPS (eu-west-1): baseline 1.9k -> 2.4k
Median latency: unchanged (~120ms) but p95 +60ms if no pre-warm/autoscale tweak
Lucy: Ok. If chat gen is dominant, batching patterns change and we lose some batching efficiency (shorter batches but more concurrent sessions). Short-term ops levers: raise min replicas for frontend and model pool in eu-west-1 by +4 nodes, enable aggressive KV prefix caching for pro/free routing, and apply per-account soft rate caps on free credits.
Allan: Can we pre-warm without blowing on-demand spend? Ops risk/estimate?
Lucy: Suggest spot-first pre-warm for 72h window and keep 2 on-demand as buffer. Estimated incremental spot cost ~+$12k for first 2 weeks, on-demand worst-case +$38k. :eyes:
Meera: Finance needs a sketch for this. @Jae can you run the cost delta and recommend reserve vs pay-as-you-go?
Jae: Quick back-of-envelope: +22% GPU hours maps to ~$48k/mo on our current spot mix, or ~$120k/mo if most runs hit on-demand. For a 2-week promo I recommend purchasing a 50% reserved block for eu-west-1 and using spot for scale. I'll draft numbers in the shared finance doc.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] autoscaler policy "promo-throttle-eu" merged to staging by Lucy at 2026-01-11T09:15Z :white_check_mark:
Samir: Actionable items I can take this afternoon: run an end-to-end stratified sim (cohorts + seq-length distrib), output per-model GPU-hr delta, and add a sensitivity sweep for rate-limits. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Allan: Nice. Prioritized action list: 1) Finance (Meera/Jae) confirm budget & reserve plan 2) Samir run full sim + paste CSV to /shared/sim/promo-2026/ (include per-region, per-model) 3) Lucy open PR for pre-warm autoscaler + rate-limiter policy 4) Ops to stage 4-node pre-warm in eu-west-1 and monitor headroom 5) Contingency: if usage >+30% activate EU fallback routing to lower-capacity models. Deadline: EOD Friday. Ping if blocked.
Meera: Capturing. I'll coordinate with marketing to get exact promo windows and expected user counts.
Samir: Pushed full sim: /shared/sim/promo-2026/eu_summary.csv — key excerpt: Week1_total_gpu_hrs,5150;Week1_peak_qps,2400;Week1_p95_latency_increase_ms,60
ops-bot: [alert] eu-west-1 pool usage 78% (4 nodes spare), projected 91% at current sim peak without pre-warm :warning:
Lucy: I'll open the PR now for min-replicas bump + rate-limit rules. Will include a checklist for pre-warm teardown after promo window.
Jae: I'll post finance numbers and a recommendation doc link in this thread when ready. If finance approves, we can convert the prepaid block within 24h.
Allan: Thanks all. If anyone sees the alert spike come early, drop an @here in #eng-infra and we'll run the fallback. :thumbsup:
